_comment: Hand-maintained map from ComCat event id to an Earthquake Insights post.
The site shows a 'Read our analysis' link on any listed event in the
largest-events panel. Event ids are visible in the USGS link on each row,
and in the URL of any earthquake.usgs.gov event page.
This file is NOT generated by the pipeline -- pipeline/build.py writes to
this directory but never touches posts.json, so entries added here survive
One event may only point at one post; put the best single post for it.
